transcript: Your policy deck already holds your compliance training. Here's how to turn it into a clear narrated video, without a studio or voice talent.
Start from the approved policy, then strip out the background and history. Staff mainly need the rule, why it matters, and what to do.
Rewrite every headline as an instruction. 'Gifts and hospitality' becomes: declare any gift over the policy limit within five working days.
Your speaker notes become the narration, so write them like you'd explain the rule to a colleague. Then add a scenario, like Priya and the supplier hamper, so it sticks.
Turn captions on and check contrast, at least 4.5 to 1, so everyone can follow. When a threshold changes, edit the slide and note, export again.
Try Basic first, with narration, captions and transitions. On Pro, a.i. directs your video, one clear scene per rule. Start at powerpoint2vid.com.
